shared_facts.value: A strict distinction must be preserved between real notebook notes and synthesized text sources [1].
Note export is explicitly unsupported and should not be promised or assigned to this screen [1-3].
Any note-to-source bridge must remain an explicit action rather than an implicit system behavior [1].
The user-facing CLI contract should hide the implementation detail that mind maps are stored using note-backed internals [2, 4].

fe_facts.value: The CLI note surface provides specific CRUD commands: list, create, get, save, rename, and delete [3].
The command `notebooklm history --save` creates a real notebook note via the notes.create API [5].
CLI chat affordances such as `ask --save-as-note` are registered in src/notebooklm/cli/chat.py [4].

be_facts.value: The underlying substrate for note operations is src/notebooklm/_notes.py, which exposes full note CRUD [4].
src/notebooklm/client.py exposes 'notes' as a first-class namespaced API [6].
There is currently no dedicated MCP tool module for notes in src/notebooklm_mcp/tools/__init__.py [7].

dependencies: artifact-export-hub (regarding note-backed storage of mind-map artifacts)
chat-interaction-configuration (for note-saving behavior in chat flows)
cli-source-management-console (for distinguishing text sources from notes)

claims.claim: The workflow research helper (notebooklm_workflow_research) saves 'research notes' as text sources via client.sources.add_text() [4, 8].
The chat helper (notebooklm_chat_ask) saves real notebook notes via client.notes.create() [8].

contradictions.open_question: How should the BA adapter normalize these behaviors to provide a consistent 'create notebook note' semantic for downstream modules? [8]

missing_info.summary: Specific implementation details for the 'note-to-source' bridge, which is currently described only as synthesized text-source creation or curated-source capture [3].

open_questions.summary: Note-to-source conversion remains an explicit bridge rather than an automated flow [4, 7].
Should 'note-to-source' conversion be introduced as a first-class CLI action in future phases, given it is currently not a first-class CLI note action? [3]

notes: Source 22 provides an explicit list of CLI commands for the note manager.
The facts clearly distinguish between the robust SDK/CLI note support and the fragmented/absent MCP support [4, 9, 10].
